title: HUME: MEASURING THE HUMAN-MODEL PERFORMANCE GAP IN TEXT EMBEDDING TASKS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the performance gap between human annotators and text embedding models across diverse high- and low-resource languages (e.g., English, Arabic, Russian, Danish, Norwegian) to identify disparities in cross-cultural semantic understanding and disproportionate dataset quality issues.

Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) as automated annotators by comparing their outputs against human judgments on identical tasks to identify systematic deviations and biases in capturing fine-grained semantic distinctions.
